texts.text:
The Dohkar's voice cuts across the clearing before the last echo of my words has died.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "A preliminary review is required."

The assembly shifts, a single wave of breath and fabric moving through the rings.

My step back still hangs between us, the grass crushed under my heel.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The matter will be placed before a Chayr and two Dohkars."

The words land like a hand on my shoulder, heavy and deliberate.

Julian has not moved, but the air around him has changed.

JULIAN: "Agreed."

His voice carries the weight of a decision already made.

The scar on his wrist catches the light when he shifts his stance.

Seren remains kneeling, her small frame the only still point in the shifting crowd.

The Dohkar's gaze settles on me again, heavier now.

I feel the weight of the review settle into the grass between us.

The Answer lies still in my hands, its double-ended shaft catching the last light.

The clearing has changed shape around the words now spoken.

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — “Petition Fate” is inscribed in it.

I pull the deck from my sash, the gold cards heavy in my palm.

The clearing feels too open, the grass pressing up against my bare feet.

I need something small, something that might tip the moment without costing everything.

I draw a single card and speak the wish under my breath.

LIRAEL: "I wish for the strength to face what comes next without breaking."

A small breeze stirs the spiralgrass at the edge of the ring, nothing more.

The presiding Dohkar steps forward, his voice cutting through the dispersing assembly.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The memory of the scar on the Provast's wrist is the price that must be paid."

The words land like a hand pressing down on my shoulder.

Julian has not moved, but the air around him has changed.

I lift my gaze to meet his, the uncertainty I have been holding slipping through.

LIRAEL: "I feel lost, and I can't pretend otherwise."

Julian's gaze remains fixed, the intensity registering the shift I forced into view.

Seren stays kneeling, her small frame the only still point left in the clearing.

The scar on his wrist catches the last light when he shifts his stance.

The demand hangs between us, heavier than the grass under my heel.

I cannot give that memory without losing something I do not yet understand.

The clearing has changed shape around the words now spoken.

Julian's presence bends the air without him moving a step.

The Answer lies still in my hands, its weight no longer mine to shape.

I realize the deck is still in my hand. As I slide Petition Fate back in, I notice a flash of red in the otherwise gold stack. “Tempt Fate.” Great-grandma never let me play with that one. A sword raised to a blood-red sky, lightning arcing down from the clouds (or maybe arcing up?) Ow! Static shock reminds me I need to pay attention to the present…

The alcove feels smaller than the clearing ever did.

The presiding Dohkar stands at the threshold, gloved hands folded.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The rite is concluded. Your conduct remains under review."

The words settle like a second band across my mouth.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "You will speak to no one of the rite until the inquiry concludes."

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The Provast has called for review of your conduct."

Julian has not moved, yet the air bends around him.

I step closer, my shoulder brushing his.

LIRAEL: "What if I just let everyone see us?"

The assembly's murmurs still at the edge of the alcove.

Julian's gaze remains fixed on me.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "You will remain under supervision until the matter is resolved."

The scar on his wrist catches the last light.

The demand hangs heavier than the grass under my heel.

I cannot give that memory without losing something I do not yet understand.

Julian's presence bends the air without him moving a step.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The restrictions stand. You are not to leave the grounds."

The Answer lies still in my hands, its weight no longer mine.

Julian's eyes sharpen, the intensity of his focus thickening the air.

The clearing has changed shape around the words now spoken.

I must choose whether to accept the restrictions while addressing him or dispute his role before them all.

oas.liDialogue: You shaped Seren’s wish through your desirability alone, every gesture in the rite calling my eyes to you. Did you summon me hoping I would claim the blame and rescue you from it?
